_readme: Direct addresses of Government Order PDFs, for the first load of the library.
Why this exists: the goir.ap.gov.in collector has to drive a search page whose
markup nobody has verified. These are links straight to the PDFs, so a first
batch can be collected without depending on that. Both paths end in the same
IMPORTANT — `claim` is NOT data. It is what a web search said about the
document, recorded so a reviewer knows what to expect when the PDF opens. Every
field that reaches the library is read from the PDF itself by the extractor,
and an administrator approves it before anything is published. If the PDF
disagrees with the claim here, the PDF is right and this file is wrong.
Add to it freely. `pnpm --filter @ap-emp-ai/ingest fetch:seeds` downloads
everything listed, skips what is already known by content hash, and queues the
